The M2 virus will turn those infected into futanari, regardless of gender.

Infected either pass this stage becoming Machina or can be cured if caught early enough. Infected individuals will establish a core within their bodies as their internal organs are converted into M2 production organs. Once a core is established, an infected cannot be cured.

Machina in this category retain most of their human appearance however, the installation of Machinium is evident, with the majority of their limbs modified. This is the last state the infected will enter before losing their mind to corruption, however it still possesses some control over the infected. This will occur once a larva bonds with their core.

The majority of Machina end up in this category, identified by their bodies taking on a full unnatural transformation. Ultimately, Machina in this category lose their mind to the M2 virus, becoming drones for the corruption. Usually, it takes 1 full month to develop to this stage, however it can be sped up with additional M2 or larvae, occasionally some Queens can slow down this process too. Notably possessing a third eye on their foreheads, typically called the Queen's eye and is a symbol of a fully developed Machina brain and horns.

Machina obtain this class when ascending to Category 4, whilst retaining their original abilities. These Machina appear to possess more of a personality than other classes. It is currently unknown how these Machina reached this state. Reports are known about such beings, Uroboros, Behemoth, Jagannath, Jangsan Beom, Shiva, Thoth and Belphegor.
